title: Object-level permissions and passwordless access
summary: Grant least-privilege permissions and adopt passwordless (Entra/Managed Identity) authentication.

items: Implement passwordless access with Microsoft Entra and Managed Identity.

blocks.body: Permissions and passwordless auth are foundational to secure DP-800 solutions, especially for AI service connections.

terms.definition: Granting only the permissions a principal needs to do its job.
An Entra identity for Azure resources that removes the need for stored credentials.

blocks.body: Use `GRANT`/`DENY`/`REVOKE` on specific objects and prefer roles over per-user grants. **Passwordless** access uses Microsoft Entra authentication and **Managed Identity** so no secrets are stored — the recommended approach for app and AI-service connections.
DENY overrides GRANT. Assign permissions to roles, add users to roles, and use Managed Identity for service-to-database connections.

tips: Passwordless + Managed Identity is the preferred answer for connecting apps/AI services securely.

blocks.body: Grant least privilege via roles and go passwordless with Entra/Managed Identity for service connections.
